correctness.rationale: Exact two parity secular equations were derived from positive Floquet matching and checked against independent finite Jacobi eigenvalue calculations; their zero-parameter limits give known finite-m thresholds. Symbolic derivatives and uniformly regularized Taylor expansion at kappa=O(m^-2) give c_m(kappa)=C_m+D kappa+O(m^-1 kappa+m kappa²), whence m² kappa->(xi-B)_+/D and dispersion E+D kappa² produces the exact m⁴ gap. On supercritical subsequences the normalized periodic Bloch tail has length m² and shrinking relative left mass O(1/m), establishing strong exponential L² profile. Multiple high-precision diagnostics pass. Boundary xi=B only asserts zero scaled gap, not existence.

value.rationale: The already known parity-dependent threshold answers only whether a bound state exists. The new exact fourth-order excess and m² localization quantify a sharply tuned boundary of a natural alternating Jacobi/shift model, separating two parity-dependent phases of near-edge spectral binding; neither a fixed-c radius nor a binary threshold supplies those observables. The constants are structural functions of two bulk weights, not arbitrarily selected tabulated parameters.
